name: teamai
description: TeamAi — Provider-Federated AI Team Workspace (Firebase + Supabase backend architecture)

scripts.build: npm run machine:sync && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node build-system/scripts/copy-public.mjs
scripts.test:machine: npm run machine:sync && node --check public/machine-hero-webgl.js && node --check public/machine-core-visual.js && node --check public/machine-core-interaction.js && node --check public/machine-core-animation.js && node --check public/machine-core-hit-testing.js && node --check public/machine-core-layout-runtime.js && node --check frontend/spatial/machine-core-animation.js && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/machine-hero-scene.test.mjs tests/machine-hero-payload.test.mjs tests/machine-hero-graph.test.mjs tests/machine-hero-webgl.test.mjs tests/machine-core-layout.test.mjs tests/machine-core-animation.test.mjs tests/machine-core-hit-testing.test.mjs tests/machine-hero-adaptive-geometry.test.mjs tests/machine-hero-topology.test.mjs tests/machine-hero-topology-generalized.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run seat:provider:wire && npm run build && node --check public/hero-flex.js && npm run test:machine && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run seat:provider:wire && npm run build && node --check public/hero-flex.js && npm run test:machine && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run seat:provider:wire && npm run build && node --check public/hero-flex.js && npm run test:machine && playwright test
